leads.claim: An audience member claims to have video evidence of UAP flying over Sandia Labs and Kirtland Air Force Base.
leads.why: The claim refers to aerial sightings only and contains no assertion of physical material recovery or custody.
leads.quote: three different examples of glowing dots flying in circles or going over Sandia Labs

leads.claim: A speaker suggests that engineers from Lockheed Martin and Raytheon should be allowed to speak about UAP-related secrecy.
leads.why: This is a general call for transparency regarding contractors without alleging the possession of physical material.
leads.quote: pull up engineers out of Lockheed Martin, Raytheon, and allow them the freedom to speak

doc_verdict: This document contains no evidence or credible suggestions that the government or its contractors have obtained, held, or analyzed physical UAP material; it is a transcript of a Senate hearing focused on administrative oversight, sensor data, and public testimony regarding sightings.
